### Endings of the Union ########################################################

COLDWAR_SU_after_focus = {
	COLDWAR_SU_after_change = yes
	mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
}

COLDWAR_SU_end_common = {
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_SU_ended
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_ended_here
	news_event = { id = COLDWAR_SU.71 hours = 6 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_left }
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
	}
	mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
}

COLDWAR_SU_end_federation = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SU_end_federation_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SU_ended } log = "[GetDateText]: the Union has already ended" }
		else = { COLDWAR_SU_do_end_federation = yes }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SU_do_end_federation = {
	hidden_effect = {
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_SU_end_federation
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SU_end = 1 }
		COLDWAR_SU_end_common = yes
		every_subject_country = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes }
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_SU_fragile_federation_ssr
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_EB_doctrine = 2 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_EB_doctrine_brezhnev } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_EB_doctrine_brezhnev }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_EB_doctrine_sinatra } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_EB_doctrine_sinatra }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_EB_doctrine_restraint } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_EB_doctrine_restraint }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_kind = 2 }
		COLDWAR_SU_shock_allies = yes
		if = { limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EB_communist_rules = yes } } drop_cosmetic_tag = yes }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SU_end_junta = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SU_end_junta_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SU_ended } log = "[GetDateText]: the Union has already ended" }
		else = { COLDWAR_SU_do_end_junta = yes }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SU_do_end_junta = {
	hidden_effect = {
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_SU_end_junta
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SU_end = 2 }
		COLDWAR_SU_end_common = yes
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_SU_siege_economy
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_EB_doctrine = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_EB_doctrine_restraint } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_EB_doctrine_restraint }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_EB_doctrine_sinatra } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_EB_doctrine_sinatra }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_EB_doctrine_brezhnev } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_EB_doctrine_brezhnev }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_SU_fear_doubled
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_kind = 3 }
		COLDWAR_SU_shock_allies = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_SU_end_commonwealth = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SU_end_commonwealth_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SU_ended } log = "[GetDateText]: the Union has already ended" }
		else = { COLDWAR_SU_do_end_commonwealth = yes }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SU_do_end_commonwealth = {
	hidden_effect = {
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_SU_end_commonwealth
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SU_end = 3 }
		every_subject_country = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes }
			COLDWAR_SU_ssr_leaves = yes
		}
		COLDWAR_SU_end_after_collapse = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_SU_end_collapse = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SU_end_collapse_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SU_ended } log = "[GetDateText]: the Union has already ended" }
		else = { COLDWAR_SU_do_end_collapse = yes }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SU_do_end_collapse = {
	hidden_effect = {
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_SU_end_collapse
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SU_end = 4 }
		every_subject_country = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes }
			COLDWAR_SU_ssr_leaves = yes
		}
		drop_cosmetic_tag = yes
		COLDWAR_SU_end_after_collapse = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_SU_end_after_collapse = {
	COLDWAR_SU_end_common = yes
	# the Comecon ends with the Union (dissolved 28 June 1991)
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_dissolved } } COLDWAR_CMEA_special_dissolve = yes }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_kind = 1 }
	COLDWAR_SU_shock_allies = yes
	COLDWAR_SU_ladder_start = yes
	COLDWAR_SU_cycle_lock_start = yes
	COLDWAR_SU_leave = yes
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EB_democratised
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_post_soviet
	if = { limit = { NOT = { country_exists = CHE } owns_state = 672 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SU.75 days = 60 } }
	# North Korea loses its Soviet oil and grain: the Arduous March begins
	if = { limit = { country_exists = NKO NKO = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EB_member } } NKO = { COLDWAR_SU_am_start = yes } }
}

COLDWAR_SU_chechen_revolt = {
	# scope: the Soviet Union. Ichkeria rises with the Soviet arsenals of Grozny.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { country_exists = CHE } owns_state = 672 }
		672 = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_core_of = CHE } } add_core_of = CHE } }
		release = CHE
		CHE = {
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_SU_chechen_resistance
			add_manpower = 40000
			add_war_support = 0.3
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_ichkeria
		}
		if = { limit = { country_exists = CHE } transfer_units_fraction = { target = CHE size = 0.01 stockpile_ratio = 0.02 army_ratio = 1 navy_ratio = 0 air_ratio = 0 } }
		news_event = { id = COLDWAR_SU.77 hours = 6 }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SU.76 days = 3 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SU_shock_allies = {
	# temp COLDWAR_SU_t_kind: 1 collapse or commonwealth, 2 federation, 3 junta
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { original_tag = SOV }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_left }
			NOT = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes }
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EB_member
			OR = {
				is_subject_of = SOV
				AND = { has_variable = mdcw_cw_alignment check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
			}
		}
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SU.73 days = 2 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SU_ssr_leaves = {
	# scope: the republic that leaves the Union
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_left
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = SOV NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_held_by_force } }
		if = { limit = { original_tag = UKR } SOV = { transfer_units_fraction = { target = PREV size = 0.18 stockpile_ratio = 1 army_ratio = 1 navy_ratio = 0 air_ratio = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { original_tag = UZB } SOV = { transfer_units_fraction = { target = PREV size = 0.07 stockpile_ratio = 1 army_ratio = 1 navy_ratio = 0 air_ratio = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { original_tag = KAZ } SOV = { transfer_units_fraction = { target = PREV size = 0.06 stockpile_ratio = 1 army_ratio = 1 navy_ratio = 0 air_ratio = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { original_tag = BLR } SOV = { transfer_units_fraction = { target = PREV size = 0.04 stockpile_ratio = 1 army_ratio = 1 navy_ratio = 0 air_ratio = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { original_tag = GEO } SOV = { transfer_units_fraction = { target = PREV size = 0.02 stockpile_ratio = 1 army_ratio = 1 navy_ratio = 0 air_ratio = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { original_tag = AZE } SOV = { transfer_units_fraction = { target = PREV size = 0.02 stockpile_ratio = 1 army_ratio = 1 navy_ratio = 0 air_ratio = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { original_tag = LIT } SOV = { transfer_units_fraction = { target = PREV size = 0.02 stockpile_ratio = 1 army_ratio = 1 navy_ratio = 0 air_ratio = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { original_tag = ARM } SOV = { transfer_units_fraction = { target = PREV size = 0.015 stockpile_ratio = 1 army_ratio = 1 navy_ratio = 0 air_ratio = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { original_tag = LAT } SOV = { transfer_units_fraction = { target = PREV size = 0.015 stockpile_ratio = 1 army_ratio = 1 navy_ratio = 0 air_ratio = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { original_tag = MLV } SOV = { transfer_units_fraction = { target = PREV size = 0.015 stockpile_ratio = 1 army_ratio = 1 navy_ratio = 0 air_ratio = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { original_tag = EST } SOV = { transfer_units_fraction = { target = PREV size = 0.01 stockpile_ratio = 1 army_ratio = 1 navy_ratio = 0 air_ratio = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { original_tag = KYR } SOV = { transfer_units_fraction = { target = PREV size = 0.01 stockpile_ratio = 1 army_ratio = 1 navy_ratio = 0 air_ratio = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { original_tag = TAJ } SOV = { transfer_units_fraction = { target = PREV size = 0.01 stockpile_ratio = 1 army_ratio = 1 navy_ratio = 0 air_ratio = 1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { original_tag = TRK } SOV = { transfer_units_fraction = { target = PREV size = 0.01 stockpile_ratio = 1 army_ratio = 1 navy_ratio = 0 air_ratio = 1 } } }
	}
	if = { limit = { is_subject_of = SOV } SOV = { end_puppet = PREV } }
	COLDWAR_UNI_leave_union = yes
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SU_fragile_federation_ssr } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SU_fragile_federation_ssr }
	COLDWAR_SU_ladder_start = yes
	COLDWAR_SU_cycle_lock_start = yes
	news_event = { id = COLDWAR_SU.74 hours = 6 }
	mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
}

### The ladder after the Union ##################################################

COLDWAR_SU_ladder_start = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_SU_lad } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_lad = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_lad = 0 } }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_lad = 1 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_lad_end = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_lad_end = 730 }
		if = {
			limit = { original_tag = SOV }
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_rus_1
			set_temp_variable = { debt_change = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { debt_change = 0.15 }
			modify_debt_effect = yes
			if = { limit = { has_idea = economic_boom } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = economic_boom add_idea = depression } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_idea = fast_growth } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = fast_growth add_idea = depression } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_idea = stable_growth } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = stable_growth add_idea = depression } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_idea = stagnation } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = stagnation add_idea = depression } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_idea = recession } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = recession add_idea = depression } }
		}
		else = {
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_ssr_1
			decrease_economic_growth = yes
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = corruption_level_10 } } increase_corruption = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = corruption_level_10 } } increase_corruption = yes }
		add_to_variable = { print_money_inflation_pressure = 0.1 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SU_ladder_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_lad > 0 } check_variable = { global.num_days > COLDWAR_SU_lad_end } }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_lad_end = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_lad_end = 730 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_lad = 1 } }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_lad = 2 }
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_rus_1 } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_rus_1 add_idea = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_rus_2 } }
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_ssr_1 } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_ssr_1 add_idea = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_ssr_2 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_lad = 2 } }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_lad = 3 }
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_rus_2 } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_rus_2 add_idea = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_rus_3 } }
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_ssr_2 } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_ssr_2 add_idea = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_ssr_3 } }
		}
		else = { COLDWAR_SU_ladder_end = yes }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SU_ladder_end = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_lad = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_rus_1 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_rus_1 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_rus_2 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_rus_2 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_rus_3 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_rus_3 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_ssr_1 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_ssr_1 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_ssr_2 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_ssr_2 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_ssr_3 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SU_ladder_ssr_3 }
}

COLDWAR_SU_cycle_lock_start = {
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_SU_cycle_lock days = 365 value = 1 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_cycle_id = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = depression } set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_cycle_id = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = recession } set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_cycle_id = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = stagnation } set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_cycle_id = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = stable_growth } set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_cycle_id = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = fast_growth } set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_cycle_id = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = economic_boom } set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_cycle_id = 6 } }
}

COLDWAR_SU_cycle_lock_monthly = {
	# the economic cycle may not be changed for one year after the end of the Union
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_cyc = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = depression } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_cyc = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = recession } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_cyc = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = stagnation } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_cyc = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = stable_growth } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_cyc = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = fast_growth } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_cyc = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = economic_boom } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_cyc = 6 } }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_cyc = COLDWAR_SU_cycle_id } } check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_cycle_id > 0 } }
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: economic cycle locked after the end of the Union, restored"
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_cycle_id = 1 } } if = { limit = { has_idea = recession } remove_ideas = recession } if = { limit = { has_idea = stagnation } remove_ideas = stagnation } if = { limit = { has_idea = stable_growth } remove_ideas = stable_growth } if = { limit = { has_idea = fast_growth } remove_ideas = fast_growth } if = { limit = { has_idea = economic_boom } remove_ideas = economic_boom } add_ideas = depression }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_cycle_id = 2 } } if = { limit = { has_idea = depression } remove_ideas = depression } if = { limit = { has_idea = stagnation } remove_ideas = stagnation } if = { limit = { has_idea = stable_growth } remove_ideas = stable_growth } if = { limit = { has_idea = fast_growth } remove_ideas = fast_growth } if = { limit = { has_idea = economic_boom } remove_ideas = economic_boom } add_ideas = recession }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_cycle_id = 3 } } if = { limit = { has_idea = depression } remove_ideas = depression } if = { limit = { has_idea = recession } remove_ideas = recession } if = { limit = { has_idea = stable_growth } remove_ideas = stable_growth } if = { limit = { has_idea = fast_growth } remove_ideas = fast_growth } if = { limit = { has_idea = economic_boom } remove_ideas = economic_boom } add_ideas = stagnation }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_cycle_id = 4 } } if = { limit = { has_idea = depression } remove_ideas = depression } if = { limit = { has_idea = recession } remove_ideas = recession } if = { limit = { has_idea = stagnation } remove_ideas = stagnation } if = { limit = { has_idea = fast_growth } remove_ideas = fast_growth } if = { limit = { has_idea = economic_boom } remove_ideas = economic_boom } add_ideas = stable_growth }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_cycle_id = 5 } } if = { limit = { has_idea = depression } remove_ideas = depression } if = { limit = { has_idea = recession } remove_ideas = recession } if = { limit = { has_idea = stagnation } remove_ideas = stagnation } if = { limit = { has_idea = stable_growth } remove_ideas = stable_growth } if = { limit = { has_idea = economic_boom } remove_ideas = economic_boom } add_ideas = fast_growth }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_cycle_id = 6 } } if = { limit = { has_idea = depression } remove_ideas = depression } if = { limit = { has_idea = recession } remove_ideas = recession } if = { limit = { has_idea = stagnation } remove_ideas = stagnation } if = { limit = { has_idea = stable_growth } remove_ideas = stable_growth } if = { limit = { has_idea = fast_growth } remove_ideas = fast_growth } add_ideas = economic_boom }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SU_country_monthly = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_lad > 0 } } COLDWAR_SU_ladder_monthly = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_am_on } COLDWAR_SU_am_monthly = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_cycle_lock } COLDWAR_SU_cycle_lock_monthly = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_nuke_upkeep }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_t_pct = 0.08333 }
		COLDWAR_EB_pay = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_breaking_codes }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_t_pct = 0.16667 }
		COLDWAR_EB_pay = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_disarm_aid }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_t_pct = 0.04167 }
		COLDWAR_EB_income = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_winter_pending NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_frozen_kettle } }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_winter_pending
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_pressure = 30 }
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_EB_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SU_union_dissolves_check = {
	# scope: the Soviet Union. When most republics have gone, the Union is over.
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_gone = 0 }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = EST EST = { NOT = { is_subject_of = SOV } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_gone = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = LAT LAT = { NOT = { is_subject_of = SOV } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_gone = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = LIT LIT = { NOT = { is_subject_of = SOV } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_gone = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = UKR UKR = { NOT = { is_subject_of = SOV } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_gone = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = BLR BLR = { NOT = { is_subject_of = SOV } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_gone = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = MLV MLV = { NOT = { is_subject_of = SOV } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_gone = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = GEO GEO = { NOT = { is_subject_of = SOV } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_gone = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = ARM ARM = { NOT = { is_subject_of = SOV } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_gone = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = AZE AZE = { NOT = { is_subject_of = SOV } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_gone = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = KAZ KAZ = { NOT = { is_subject_of = SOV } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_gone = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = UZB UZB = { NOT = { is_subject_of = SOV } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_gone = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = TRK TRK = { NOT = { is_subject_of = SOV } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_gone = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = KYR KYR = { NOT = { is_subject_of = SOV } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_gone = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = TAJ TAJ = { NOT = { is_subject_of = SOV } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_gone = 1 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_gone > 7 } NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SU_ended } NOT = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SU_which_way_out } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SU.72 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SU_lose_civ = {
	random_owned_controlled_state = {
		limit = { is_core_of = ROOT check_variable = { building_level@industrial_complex > 1 } }
		remove_building = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SU_gain_civ = {
	random_owned_controlled_state = {
		limit = { is_core_of = ROOT free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = no } }
		add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SU_shock_apply = {
	# scope: a communist ally of the Soviet Union; global COLDWAR_SU_end says how the Union ended
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SU_end > 2.5 } }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_SU_shock_collapse days = 1095 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_unrest = 20 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_pressure = 15 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_t_chance = 50 }
		COLDWAR_EB_spark_roll = yes
		if = { limit = { original_tag = CUB } add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_SU_special_period days = 1825 } }
		if = { limit = { OR = { original_tag = VIE original_tag = MON } } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_SU_reform_cheap days = 1825 value = 1 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SU_end = 1 } }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_SU_shock_federation days = 1095 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_unrest = 10 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_pressure = 5 }
	}
	else = {
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_SU_shock_junta days = 1095 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_unrest = -10 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_pressure = 20 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_EB_unrest min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_EB_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
}

### The Arduous March (North Korea) ##############################################

COLDWAR_SU_am_start = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_am_on } NOT = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SU_the_march_is_over } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_am_on
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_am_seen
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_am_months = 0 }
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_SU_arduous_march_1
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SU.400 days = 1 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SU_the_soviet_oil_stops } } complete_national_focus = COLDWAR_SU_the_soviet_oil_stops }
	}
}

COLDWAR_SU_am_monthly = {
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_am_months = 1 }
	# the aid runs out after a year: ask again or do without
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = COLDWAR_SU_am_aid_next check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_am_months = COLDWAR_SU_am_aid_next } OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_am_world has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_am_china } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SU.412 }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_am_months = 6 } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SU.401 } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SU_the_fertiliser_runs_out } } complete_national_focus = COLDWAR_SU_the_fertiliser_runs_out } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_am_months = 12 } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SU.402 } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SU_the_rations_stop } } complete_national_focus = COLDWAR_SU_the_rations_stop } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_am_months = 24 } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SU.403 } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SU_the_great_floods } } complete_national_focus = COLDWAR_SU_the_great_floods } }
}

COLDWAR_SU_am_end = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_am_on
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SU_arduous_march_1 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SU_arduous_march_1 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SU_arduous_march_2 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SU_arduous_march_2 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SU_arduous_march_3 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SU_arduous_march_3 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SU_arduous_march_4 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SU_arduous_march_4 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SU_am_foreign_eyes } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SU_am_foreign_eyes }
}

COLDWAR_SU_am_relief = {
	# temporary help only: one year of food, the famine itself stays (temp COLDWAR_SU_t_aid: 1 the West, 2 China)
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_aid = 2 } } add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_SU_am_chinese_rice days = 365 } }
	else = { add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_SU_am_food_aid days = 365 } }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_am_aid_next = COLDWAR_SU_am_months }
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_am_aid_next = 12 }
}

COLDWAR_SU_ui_frames = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_sec = 1 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_s1 = 2 } } else = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_s1 = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_sec = 2 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_s2 = 2 } } else = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_s2 = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_sec = 3 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_s3 = 2 } } else = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_s3 = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_info = 3 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_i3 = 2 } } else = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_i3 = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_info = 2 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_i2 = 2 } } else = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_i2 = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_info = 1 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_i1 = 2 } } else = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_i1 = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_nat = 1 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_n1 = 2 } } else = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_n1 = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_nat = 2 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_n2 = 2 } } else = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_n2 = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_nat = 3 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_n3 = 2 } } else = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_n3 = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_cad = 1 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_c1 = 2 } } else = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_c1 = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_cad = 2 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_c2 = 2 } } else = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_bf_c2 = 1 } }
}
